ValidationRule.description: Use the ASU Communication Guide styles (e.g 10 a.m, noon, 1:30 p.m.), 15 minute increments only. See https://commguide.asu.edu/standards/writing/days
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: NOT( OR( LEN ( Event_Start_Time__c ) = 0, or (REGEX( Event_Start_Time__c , "[1-9]{1}:[0-5]{1}[0,5]{1} [a.m.,p.m.]{4}"), (REGEX( Event_Start_Time__c , "[1]{1}[0-1]{1}:[0-5]{1}[0,5]{1} [a.m.,p.m.]{4}")), (REGEX( Event_Start_Time__c ,"[1]{1}[2]{1}:[0-5]{1}[0,5]{1} [a.m.,p.m.]{4}")), (REGEX( Event_Start_Time__c , "[1-9]{1} [a.m.,p.m.]{4}")), (REGEX( Event_Start_Time__c , "[1]{1}[0-1]{1} [a.m.,p.m.]{4}")), (REGEX (Event_Start_Time__c, "[a-z]{4}")))))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Use the ASU Communication Guide styles (e.g. 10 a.m. - noon - 1:30 p.m.), 5 minute increments only. https://commguide.asu.edu/standards/writing/days
